detail: A strict single-entry screen requires the organiser to state that only one entry, no rebuy and no add-on are permitted. No official document retrieved states that. Venetian single-day structure sheets are silent on re-entry. Wynn, Bellagio, Caesars Palace and Wynn daily terms all state re-entry or rebuy rights explicitly. MGM Grand states neither.
title: No event anywhere is confirmed single-entry by an official source

detail: All 37 DSE IV structure sheets list buy-in allocation, late registration, starting chips and level length. None states whether a player may re-enter after elimination, except the multi-flight sheets, which state that a player who bags chips may not play a later flight. Absence of a prohibition is not a confirmation of single entry.
title: Venetian structure sheets do not state a re-entry, rebuy or add-on policy

detail: No official Venetian, Wynn, Bellagio, MGM Grand or Caesars page states a pedestrian walking time between a hotel tower and its poker room. Google/Apple Maps distances were not used because they are not official property sources. The 30-minute filter therefore cannot be applied to any row and remains empty.
title: Zero verified walking times for any hotel-to-poker-room pair

detail: A true nightly cost needs a dated quote for specific dates and occupancy. Only resort fees and one property's room-tax rate are published. All room-rate cells are blank; the trip estimator asks the user for a live rate rather than inventing one.
title: No dated hotel checkout total for any property

detail: Venetian hotel terms state a 13.38% Clark County Room Tax. Wynn, Bellagio and MGM Grand terms say taxes are estimated at current rates without printing a percentage. Applying 13.38% to those properties would be an inference, so the estimator applies it only to the Venetian.
title: Venetian room tax is verified only for the Venetian; other properties' rates are unstated

detail: The official poker page advertises 11 AM, 7 PM and 11 PM daily starts, but the linked schedule PDF is headed 'MGM Grand August Tournament Schedule' and lists 11:10 AM, 7:10 PM and 11:10 PM. The current applicability of those times is unconfirmed.
title: MGM Grand weekly schedule PDF is titled August with no year

detail: The $120 NLH structure allocates $92 to the prize pool, $13 house fee, $4 promotions, and a one-time voluntary $11 staff gratuity that grants 10,000 additional chips (15,000 + 10,000 = 25,000). That is money for an in-event advantage, so the event is excluded from the no-add-on group.
title: MGM Grand $11 gratuity buys 10,000 extra chips

detail: The poker room page and the series overview page both label the WPT Fall Festival (Oct 28 - Nov 15, 2026) as 'Current Series' and DeepStack Extravaganza IV (Nov 16 - Dec 23, 2026) as 'Next Series', although the DSE IV event page is live with results columns. Event facts were taken from the dedicated DSE IV schedule.
title: Venetian series page still labels the previous series as 'Current Series'

detail: In the official schedule PDF text, event 32's date cell renders as 'LIPS CHAMPIONSHIP CHAMPIES CHAMPIES CHAMPIES' rather than a date, and several row labels are truncated. Dates were taken from the HTML event page where the PDF row label was unusable; both agree elsewhere.
title: Venetian schedule PDF text layer mislabels some date cells

detail: The earliest start found in any official source is 09:10 AM (Venetian Event 46, Dec 12 turbo satellite). Wynn WPT Day 1As start at 10:00 AM (Super Gold Million, Dec 10-11). Caesars Palace's earliest daily event is 10:00 AM. An 08:00 AM start is not available in any retrieved official schedule.
title: First verified start time is 09:10 AM; no 08:00 AM tournament exists

detail: The Wynn poker page states the daily tournament schedule is suspended during each Wynn Signature, Wynn Millions and Classic tournament series. The WPT World Championship runs Nov 27 - Dec 21, 2026, which covers most of the Venetian festival window, so Wynn daily events should not be assumed to run then.
title: Wynn daily tournaments are suspended during the WPT series

detail: The official Horseshoe page states the Hall of Fame Poker Room runs '6 exciting tournament times daily' but no schedule, buy-in, guarantee or entry-limit document could be retrieved. The room is therefore listed as unverified with no event rows.
title: Horseshoe Las Vegas publishes no retrievable tournament structure

detail: This session read the WPT structures PDF chunks covering general terms, $600/$400K, TORSE, PLO $400 and Mixed Triple Draw. The $800/$1M, WPT Prime and Super Gold Million event-specific terms were not re-read, so their entry limits are shown as unverified here even though earlier sessions reported re-entry language for two of them.
title: Wynn $800 / $1M and Super Gold Million entry rules were not re-read in this session

detail: An earlier session recorded that registration-close times and chip counts are not on the official schedule page. They are on the official schedule PDF, which this session read in full. The values are now sourced to that PDF.
title: Chip counts and level lengths were previously reported as absent from official sources
